iut_type: End Product registration with prepayment requirement, first-time customer (ACCESS Corporation)
customer_question: Since we haven't done business with you before, you'll need payment up front before work begins, and your wire transfer proxy takes about 3 weeks for funds to reach SIG. Is it correct to understand the overall delivery timeline as 3 weeks from our prepayment date?
question_variants: Is the full registration timeline just the 3-week wire transfer window from our prepayment?
What's the complete sequence of steps and durations from order to final delivery?
actual_issue: As a first-time customer required to prepay before work began, the customer wanted to confirm whether the 3-week SIG wire transfer window represented the entire project timeline, or whether additional steps would extend it further.
plain_english_explanation: The 3-week SIG wire transfer window is only one stage in a longer sequential process, not the entire timeline. The full sequence is: the customer places the order and completes their internal wire transfer; the customer submits the Invoice needed for Allion's wire transfer proxy (1-2 business days); Allion arranges and completes its own wire transfer to SIG (about 3 weeks for funds to arrive); the customer provides a login account, and Allion completes registration proxy work (1-3 business days), completing certification; the customer submits the documents needed for the Compliance Folder (1-3 business days); and Allion creates and delivers the Compliance Folder (1-3 business days). Added together, the customer should expect roughly one month total from order to final Compliance Folder delivery, not just the 3-week wire transfer window alone.
consultant_answer: The 3-week SIG wire transfer window is just one stage, not the full timeline. Here's the complete sequence: you order and wire payment to us; you submit the Invoice we need for our wire transfer proxy (1-2 business days); we complete our wire transfer to SIG (about 3 weeks for funds to arrive); you provide a login account and we complete registration proxy work (1-3 business days), completing your certification; you submit the documents needed for the Compliance Folder (1-3 business days); and we create and deliver the Compliance Folder (1-3 business days). All together, please expect roughly one month total, not just the 3-week wire transfer window.
decision_logic: When a customer's own stated assumption about timeline only accounts for one stage of a multi-stage process, provide the complete sequential breakdown with each stage's duration rather than simply confirming or denying their partial assumption.
final_recommendation: When a first-time, prepayment-required customer asks about timeline expectations, walk through the complete sequential process (wire transfer, registration proxy, Compliance Folder document submission and creation) with each stage's duration, rather than letting a partial assumption (like 'the wire transfer window is the whole timeline') go unaddressed.
risk_if_done_wrong: Confirming only the 3-week wire transfer figure without clarifying the additional sequential stages could lead the customer to expect final delivery roughly 2-3 weeks earlier than actually achievable, creating a scheduling mismatch with their own downstream plans.
